findings.summary: Digest equality does not use hmac.compare_digest.

findings.evidence: release_policy.py:16-18 accepts roots and paths without validation; empty changes also return True.
findings.summary: Paths and roots are not validated as non-empty normalized relative POSIX paths.
Root containment uses a raw string prefix, allowing a path such as pkg-evil/file under root pkg.
Rename sources are never checked, so an out-of-scope source can pass when its destination is in scope.

findings.evidence: release_policy.py:18 reads change["path"] without checking record shape or action.
findings.summary: Malformed records and unknown actions do not consistently fail closed; a missing path raises KeyError, while an unknown action with an in-scope path passes.
